q.hi: 10,000 रुपये की मूलधन पर 5% वार्षिक ब्याज दर से 3 वर्षों के लिए चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज कितना होगा? (मानक प्रश्न 96)

exp: Compound interest = P[(1 + r/n)^(nt) - 1], where P = principal, r = annual interest rate, n = number of times interest applied per time period, t = time in years. Here, P = 10000, r = 5/100 = 0.05, n = 1, t = 3. CI = 10000[(1 + 0.05/1)^(1*3) - 1] = 1716.25

exp: A syllogism is a form of logical argument that applies deductive reasoning to arrive at a conclusion based on two propositions that are asserted or assumed to be true.

q.en: What is the area of a triangle with a base of 10 cm and a height of 6 cm? (Core Concept 99)
q.hi: आधार 10 सेंटीमीटर और ऊंचाई 6 सेंटीमीटर के एक त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल कितना होगा? (मानक प्रश्न 99)

exp: Area of a triangle = 1/2 * base * height. Here, base = 10 cm, height = 6 cm. Area = 1/2 * 10 * 6 = 30 cm²
